task: When the same option is defined on a program and its subcommand and the program value was stored with an unknown (undefined) source, getOptionValueSourceWithGlobals('common') on the subcommand reports the subcommand's own source ('cli') instead of the program's undefined source. A global source that is known already wins correctly, so the global should win here as well.
note: Repository uses node:test at this commit, jest is not installed; needs Node >= 22.12.
